resolution.note: lane start carries a locally edited tracked record into the worktree and restores the committed version in the invoking checkout.

title: Lane start carries a locally edited task record into the worktree
body:
Why: 2026-11-13 the lead ran krn task edit --append-body in the main checkout before krn lane run; the lane worktree is cut from origin/<base>, so the note never reached the worker, and the main checkout was left dirty.
Outcome: krn lane run (and lane start) carries a locally modified tracked task record into the lane worktree, as it already carries an untracked one, or refuses naming the uncommitted edit.
Proof: a test in test/cli/lane.test.ts edits a committed record locally, starts a lane, and finds the edit in the worktree record.
